title: The Gift Of Life
html:
In this weeks, MondayMotivator,

  • Your life is a precious and unique gift that should be valued.
  • Consider the purpose of your life and how you can use it to your advantage or contribute to others.
  • Avoid taking life for granted, treat it with care, and use your time wisely, recognizing it as a special privilege.

Your life is precious, and you are unique. No one else on this planet is exactly like you - maybe other planets, but not this one!

If you received a special gift, what do you do with it?

You might look at it with wonder, consider its purpose and how you could use it to your advantage. Maybe think of the enjoyment it could bring you or how it could help others.

You might feel happy that you were given it. For sure, you would treat it with care. Perhaps even reflecting on it occasionally. Never would you think of throwing it away.

Life is that special gift.

We take life for granted as if it were some right of ours. Many times, abusing the privilege because of what we do with it. Sometimes, we waste our time in idleness and sometimes when we could have used it more prudently.

Instead of using it for pure personal indulgence or frivolity, ask yourself how you could use it to serve others.

If you were asked to give an account of how you spent your life, I wonder how much would have been spent on others. How much was spent with purpose?

Be accountable for this great gift you have been given. Think each day, I will reflect on my life and treat it as a precious gift to be shared carefully and used prudently. Also, I will reflect on my life's purpose and ensure a part of it involves the elevation of others.
